source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of responsible digital behaviour (PDF 188).

blocks.text: Responsible digital behavior (zimmedarana digital rawayya) ka matlab hai technology aur internet ko izzat aur hifazat ke saath istemal karna. Is mein shamil hai:

items: Using Strong Passwords (mazboot password): Aise passwords banayein jinhein doosre aasani se andaza (guess) na kar sakein. Misal: “password123” jaisa password rakhne ke bajaye letters (huroof), numbers aur symbols (nishanat) mila kar password banayein.

Avoiding Phishing Scams (phishing ke dhokon se bachna): Mashkook links par click na karein aur anjaan logon ki woh emails na kholein jo personal maloomat maangti hain. Misal: Agar koi email bank ki hone ka daawa kare aur aap ke account ki details maange, to jawab dene se pehle tasdeeq karein ke woh asli hai ya nahi.

blocks.prompt: MCQ 10: In mein se kaunsa kaam zimmedarana digital rawayya NAHI?
blocks.explanation: (b) Social media par jhooti maloomat phailana.

items: Zimmedarana rawayya: mazboot password (letters, numbers, symbols), phishing se bachao (bank ki email ki tasdeeq).
